mutations.before:
where campaign_id = $1 and id = any($2::uuid[])
            and not exists (
              select 1 from brief_version v where v.campaign_id = $1 and position(asset.id::text in v.body) > 0
            )
          returning id
mutations.after:
where campaign_id = $1 and id = any($2::uuid[])
          returning id
mutations.because: dropping the `not exists` guard means `freeUnreferencedAssets` deletes a created id even though a committed `brief_version` still names it — a concurrent write that committed first is supposed to keep that id alive, and without the guard the delete ignores the committed version entirely. The test that catches it commits a version naming the id, then frees it, and asserts both the row and the object survive.
command: freeUnreferencedAssets keeps a created id a committed version names
